title: Hybrid-precision intake and performance attribution ledger for live regression triage
creator: Priya Desai
description: Build an intake and attribution ledger that captures hybrid-precision (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) profile metadata, per-batch microbenchmarks, and deterministic mapping from observed regression signals back to exact quant artifacts and model pins. This ticket covers the data model for the ledger, ingestion pipeline (batch and streaming), lightweight on-host smoke harness for quick isolation, and an attribution UI payload so Console and the regression watcher can present root-cause candidates.
acceptance_criteria: Schema defined for hybrid-precision profile records with immutable artifact identifiers and model pins
Ingestion pipeline implemented: nightly bulk + real-time incremental upload from canaries
Microbench harness that produces per-sequence latency/cost/quality vectors and attaches to ledger records
Attribution payload documented and available on /api/v1/quant-ledger for Console lookups
Automated regression playbook can map an alert to top-3 candidate artifacts within 10 minutes
steps_to_run_harness: Register a test profile by POSTing to /api/v1/quant-profiles with test metadata and upload weights link
Trigger the microbench runner: `python microbench/run.py --seq-len 128 --batch 8 --profile-id <id>` and wait for metrics to appear in ledger
Simulate regression: replay failing prompt set via `tools/replay/runner --profile <id> --suite smoke-regress` and confirm alert is generated
